analogy.rationale: MDM2/MDM4 inhibitors block p53 degradation, activating p53-dependent transcriptional programs (cell-cycle arrest, apoptosis) in p53-wild-type lines; TP53 inhibitors oppose this axis, while CDK and DNA-synthesis inhibitors converge on related cell-cycle/DNA-damage programs. Responses should be moderate because activity depends on p53 status and MDM4 expression across these lines.
